# ERASE Racism

> ERASE Racism NY is a Long Island-based nonprofit organization dedicated to eliminating racial disparities through housing equity, education reform, youth leadership development, and community engagement.

Founded to advance racial equity across New York, ERASE Racism operates three core programs: the Inclusive Housing Program, Education Equity Initiative, and Youth Development for Leadership. The organization combines direct service, advocacy, training, and community partnerships to create systemic change.

## Key Topics

- Racial Equity

## Core Programs

- [Areas of Work](https://eraseracismny.org/our-work): Overview of ERASE Racism's housing, education, and youth programs
- [Inclusive Housing Program](https://eraseracismny.org/our-work/housing): ERASE Racism's Inclusive Housing Program advancing fair housing on Long Island
- [Education Equity Initiative](https://eraseracismny.org/our-work/education): Education Equity Initiative addressing racial barriers in public schools
- [Youth Development for Leadership](https://eraseracismny.org/our-work/youth-development-for-leadership): Student Task Force and youth leadership development program at ERASE Racism
